Todos os endpoints usam a chave no cabeçalho X-Api-Key. Veja Autenticação.

  • getList project links

List project links#

get/v1/projects/{id}/links

Requires link.list. Lists project links with pagination and optional type/name filters. Links owned by a page are hidden unless include=pages.

Parâmetros de caminho

idstring (uuid)obrigatório

Parâmetros de consulta

pageinteger

Padrão: 1

limitinteger

Padrão: 20

typestring

Valores: generic, traffic_source, sales_platform

namestring
includestring

pages: also list links owned by pages.

Valores: pages

Exemplo
curl -X GET "https://api.trackup.me/v1/projects/{id}/links" \
  -H "X-Api-Key: $TRACKUP_API_KEY"
Respostas
200object

Project links and total count.

Create a project link or A/B test#

post/v1/projects/{id}/links

Requires link.create. Normalizes pathname with a leading slash and rejects an existing pathname with 409. A traffic_source link requires trafficSourceId. Supplied A/B test variants must include at least two pages, except for traffic_source links.

Parâmetros de caminho

idstring (uuid)obrigatório

Corpo da requisição

namestringobrigatório
pathnamestringobrigatório
typestringobrigatório

Valores: generic, traffic_source, sales_platform

trafficSourceIdstring | null (uuid)

Required for traffic_source; ignored otherwise.

salesPlatformIdstring | null (uuid)
urlsobject[]
pageIdstring (uuid)obrigatório
namestring
weightinteger

Padrão: 1

isActiveboolean
salesPlatformIdstring | null (uuid)
Exemplo
curl -X POST "https://api.trackup.me/v1/projects/{id}/links" \
  -H "X-Api-Key: $TRACKUP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "name": "string",
  "pathname": "string",
  "type": "generic",
  "trafficSourceId": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000",
  "salesPlatformId": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000",
  "urls": [
    {
      "pageId": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
    }
  ]
}'

Update a project link#

patch/v1/projects/{id}/links/{linkId}

Requires link.update. Updates supplied metadata and references. Page-owned links must be edited through their page and return 409 here. Conflicting pathnames also return 409.

Parâmetros de caminho

idstring (uuid)obrigatório
linkIdstring (uuid)obrigatório

Corpo da requisição

namestring
pathnamestring
trafficSourceIdstring | null (uuid)

Required for traffic_source; ignored otherwise.

salesPlatformIdstring | null (uuid)
Exemplo
curl -X PATCH "https://api.trackup.me/v1/projects/{id}/links/{linkId}" \
  -H "X-Api-Key: $TRACKUP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "name": "string",
  "pathname": "string",

Get link variant analytics#

get/v1/projects/{id}/links/{linkId}/analytics

Requires link.read. Returns active variants and their traffic, conversions and revenue for the supplied date interval. conversionRate is conversions divided by visitors (0 when there are no visitors). series has one point per calendar day of the interval (team timezone) with each variant's cumulative visitors, conversions and revenue. confidence is the one-sided two-proportion z-test probability that the best conversion rate beats the runner-up (null with fewer than two variants with visitors, or no conversions at all); variant assignment is not sticky per visitor, so treat it as indicative. Both date strings must be nonempty; this legacy endpoint does not validate their format.

Parâmetros de caminho

idstring (uuid)obrigatório
linkIdstring (uuid)obrigatório

Parâmetros de consulta

startDatestringobrigatório

Start of the analytics interval.

endDatestringobrigatório

End of the analytics interval.

Exemplo
curl -X GET "https://api.trackup.me/v1/projects/{id}/links/{linkId}/analytics?startDate=…&endDate=…" \
  -H "X-Api-Key: $TRACKUP_API_KEY"
Respostas

Send all A/B traffic to one variant#

post/v1/projects/{id}/links/{linkId}/promote

Requires url.update. Atomically sets weight 100 on the given active variant and 0 on the link's other active variants; variants stay active, so they keep appearing in analytics. The gateway picks up the new weights immediately. Returns 404 when the variant is not an active variant of this link.

Parâmetros de caminho

idstring (uuid)obrigatório
linkIdstring (uuid)obrigatório

Corpo da requisição

urlIdstring (uuid)obrigatório

Active variant that receives 100% of the traffic.

Exemplo
curl -X POST "https://api.trackup.me/v1/projects/{id}/links/{linkId}/promote" \
  -H "X-Api-Key: $TRACKUP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "urlId": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}'
Respostas
200object

New weights of the link's active variants.
